Canon events you experience
in your 20s

1. The law of the first lease

Your own keys, your own bills.
Freedom costs rent.

2. The law of the first boss

Good or bad,
you'll copy some of them.

3. The law of the shrinking circle

Twenty friends become four.
That's fine.

4. The law of the long drive home

The night you realize
you're in charge.

5. The law of curiosity

Learn something new every day.
The men who do never get stuck.
